messages:
elaine_rpo: Heads up — two panel interviews today showed up in candidate calendar with a 'needs-certified-interviewer' note and the interviewer slot marked as "shadow". @nora-training any idea why the scheduler is flagging folks who completed training?

nora-training: I saw one of those. Training service shows the users completed, we wrote the webhook. Not sure why scheduler sees them as uncertified.

jamie-scheduler: Looking into scheduler logs now. When we assemble the event payload we expect `certified: true`. For the affected events the payload from training-svc was missing that boolean and came through as `certified: false`.

sam-eng: Can you paste the raw payload you got?

jamie-scheduler: ```json
{"user_id":7934,"certified":false,"completed_at":"2026-03-22T09:12:34Z"}
```

nora-training: Hmm. Our sync job recently ran a DB migration and we replaced `is_cert` column with `completed_at` timestamp to remove redundant booleans. Looks like the webhook mapper wasn't updated to set `certified` fallback. The training microservice still emits `completed_at` but the mapping-service used by scheduler expected `certified` explicitly.

maria-ops: This is high priority — we can't have candidates meet with folks who haven't finished interviewer training. How many panels are affected?

elaine_rpo: I manually updated today's urgent panels in ATS with a `training:complete` tag as a temporary fix. Will do the rest if engineering can't patch fast.

sam-eng: I'll push a hotfix for mapping-service to set `certified = completed_at != null` if `certified` is missing. Also add null-safe parsing. Planning to roll to staging in ~15m.

deploy-bot: deployment mapping-service v2.14.3-hotfix started by sam-eng — staging

sam-eng: Hotfix rolled to staging. Jamie, can you re-run the scheduler check for the impacted candidate slots (IDs: 2022-887, 2022-891)?

jamie-scheduler: Re-ran for 2022-887 and 2022-891. Both now show `certified: true` and calendar invites updated. No more "shadow" label.

maria-ops: Thanks. Can we get an audit for all interviews in the last 48 hours to confirm no other unstable mappings? Also add a regression test so this migration doesn't break the flow next time.

nora-training: I'll backfill the `is_cert` boolean for the migration history and add a unit test in the sync job to populate `certified` for backward compatibility. Will also add clearer logging when required fields are missing.

elaine_rpo: Appreciate the fast turnaround. For follow-up: please post a short ops note with the root cause and the manual ATS steps we used, so recruiters know the workaround if this recurs.

sam-eng: Will create a short postmortem and add a scheduler integration test. Estimated PR + changelog by EOD.

nora-training: I'll schedule a quick 15m sync with recruiting tomorrow to walk through the fix and confirm tags.

elaine_rpo: Perfect. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
